name: SDLC
description: Engineering practice run with the human rather than recited at them. One skill carries the whole change loop, from a vague ask through discovery, a throwaway, the spec, the design, failing tests, slice-by-slice implementation, progressive rollout, verification and cleanup. Two more sit outside it: preparing a codebase for agents in any language, and recording an expensive or irreversible decision. The user, not the model, makes every judgment call.
